question: Should OpenClaw accept dashboard tab path-segment URLs now, and should that URL contract land as part of the modular-dashboard stack or wait until that stack is accepted?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new user-facing routing contract for a dashboard surface that is not on current main, and it may require changing the generic plugin-tab route rather than only a dashboard component.

options.title: Defer until dashboard stack is accepted
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical follow-up and decide the path contract after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs are reviewed or narrowed.

options.title: Sponsor a generic plugin-route extension
options.body: Have a maintainer define how plugin tabs can own path segments across all bundled and external plugin tabs before dashboard-specific code lands.

options.title: Fold into the Workspaces UI PR
options.body: Ask the dashboard UI PR to include the final route shape and upgrade tests before the Workspaces tab merges.

recommendation.title: Defer until dashboard stack is accepted
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical follow-up and decide the path contract after the Wave 1 dashboard PRs are reviewed or narrowed.

likelyOwner.reason: The current generic plugin-tab route and linked logbook seam were introduced under this owner trail, so this is the best available route-contract decision owner.
